items.title: Major: "Ich erwarte keinen großen Durchbruch" in Abu Dhabi

items.title: Two Russian Banderol missiles enter Moldovan airspace during attack on Ukraine

items.title: In Region Cherson ein Zivilist getötet, drei verletzt, 35 Ortschaften beschossen
items.teaser: Letzten Tag beschoss die russische Besatzungsarmee 30 Siedlungen in der Region Cherson. Bei Beschuss wurde ein Zivilist getötet, acht weitere verletzt.

items.title: NATO seeks to prioritise countering Russia and scale back overseas missions – Politico
items.teaser: NATO allies are discussing changes to military capability requirements that would prioritise a major conflict in Europe over simultaneous overseas crisis-management missions, amid concerns about Russian aggression.

items.title: Russian nighttime attack on Chernihiv sparks fire at private enterprise, damages vehicles
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Chernihiv overnight on November 11, sparking a fire at a private enterprise.

items.title: How Russian-linked organized crime infiltrated Ukraine's law enforcement
items.teaser: Ukraine's latest corruption scandal has exposed an unlikely alliance between organized crime and the law enforcement officials meant to fight it. items.title: Four injured in Russian drone attacks on Zhytomyr Oblast
items.teaser: Overnight Russian drone strikes have hit five communities in Zhytomyr Oblast, damaging homes and infrastructure while injuring responding National Police officers in a double-tap strike.

items.title: Jet-powered Geran drones are just the beginning. How Russia is switching to small missiles and what Ukraine can do about it
items.teaser: Ukraine has barely had time to adapt to Russian jet-powered drones, and Russia is already ramping up production of another weapon – small cruise missiles.

items.title: War update: 125 clashes on front line over past day, Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk sectors remain hottest
items.teaser: Over the past day, November 10, a total of 125 combat engagements between Ukraine’s Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line, with the heaviest enemy attacks reported in the Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk sectors.

items.title: Selenskyj: In Abu Dhabi wurde Möglichkeit eines Großgefangenenaustauschs erörtert
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte gestern Abend vor Journalisten in Dänemark, dass bei den Gesprächen in Abu Dhabi die Möglichkeit eines großangelegten Gefangenenaustauschs im Format „1.000 gegen 1.000“ oder „1.500 gegen 1.500“ erörtert wurde.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,614,180 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,580 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Drones attack Russia's strategic Ust-Luga port, sparking fire
items.teaser: On the night of Wednesday, November 11, drones struck Ust-Luga, Russia's second-largest port, located near the city of St. Petersburg.

items.title: „Spiegel“: Bundeswehr verbannt chinesische Drohnen und Autos wegen Spionagegefahr
items.teaser: Die Bundeswehr zieht bei chinesischer Technik die Reißleine. Drohnen bleiben am Boden, bestimmte Autos dürfen nicht mehr in Sicherheitsbereiche fahren.

items.title: Two Russian Banderol drone-launched missiles enter Moldova's airspace
items.teaser: Moldova's Defence Ministry says two Russian cruise missiles entered the country's airspace from Odesa Oblast on 11 November before returning to Ukrainian airspace minutes later.

items.title: Weitere hohe Kampfverluste der Russen - 2580 Soldaten am Vortag
items.teaser: Die Gesamtkampfverluste der russischen Besatzungstruppen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 11. November 2026 werden auf etwa 1.614180 (+2580 zum Vortag) getötete und verwundete Invasoren geschätzt.

items.title: Russian army loses another 2,580 personnel, two air defense systems in war against Ukraine
items.teaser: Russia's total estimated combat losses since the beginning of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, through November 11, 2026, have reached approximately 1,614,180 personnel, including 2,580 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Russians attack Ukraine with a missile and 163 drones overnight
items.teaser: Ukrainian air defences destroyed or jammed 144 Russian drones during an overnight attack. Strikes were recorded at 17 locations.

items.title: Air Defense neutralizes 14 Banderol missiles, 130 Russian drones overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 14 Banderol missiles and 130 drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine since the evening of November 10.

items.title: In Region Saporischschja 54 Ortschaften beschossen, ein Zivilist getötet, 15 verletzt
items.teaser: Am vergangenen Tag beschossen die russischen Besatzungstruppen 54 Ortschaften in der Region Saporischschja 1107 Mal.

items.title: Kharkiv hit by two consecutive missile strikes
items.teaser: Kharkiv was hit by two consecutive missile strikes targeting the city's Industrialnyi and Saltivskyi districts.

items.title: Russian drones kill 2 municipal workers, injure another in consecutive attacks on Kramatorsk
items.teaser: Honcharenko accused Russian forces of deliberately targeting people responsible for maintaining essential services in the city.

items.title: Zelensky discusses support for Ukraine with Northern European Prime Ministers amid Russian escalation
items.teaser: The President discussed the diplomatic process and support for Ukraine with the prime ministers of Northern European countries against the backdrop of Russia's escalating attacks.

items.title: Six people injured in evening Russian attacks on Zaporizhzhia district
items.teaser: Russian attacks on the Zaporizhzhia district on 10 November left six people injured and caused fires in residential buildings and a shop. Rescue workers freed two women and took them to hospital.

items.title: Kryvyi Rih under massive Russian drone attack: Parts of city without electricity and heating
items.teaser: Kryvyi Rih has come under a massive attack by Russian unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), leaving parts of the city without electricity and heating. Residential buildings, schools, and kindergartens have been damaged.

items.title: Zelensky on front line situation assessments: Putin lives in different reality
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that during today's trilateral negotiations, Russian representatives claimed that Russia had occupied parts of the Donbas that are actually under Ukrainian control. According to him, this demonstrates significant differences in how the battlefield situation is being assessed.

items.title: Europe must appoint representative for peace negotiations by end of November – Zelensky
items.teaser: Europe must decide by the end of November who will represent it in negotiations aimed at ending the war in Ukraine. Ideally, this decision should be made at a meeting in Germany on November 19.

items.title: Russia loses 2,580 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 2,580 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Zelensky presents Northern European partners with plan for getting through winter
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky presented Northern European countries with Ukraine’s winter preparedness plan, which includes additional supplies of diesel fuel and improved protection for bridges.

items.title: Poland says Pentagon green lit for permanent U.S. military base
items.teaser: Poland has received the Pentagon’s "green light" to establish a permanent U.S. military base on its territory.

items.title: EU's Costa keeps Ukraine funding talks on late-November agenda despite Merz appeal
items.teaser: Costa's response indicates plans to "make time for a broad discussion on Ukraine at the upcoming informal European Council in Dublin", but leaves the previously scheduled financing discussions unchanged.

items.title: Situation in 34 settlements in Kherson Oblast is as critical as in Oleshky
items.teaser: Oleksandr Prokudin warns that dozens of settlements along the Dnipro River are struggling with shortages of electricity, gas, water, food and humanitarian aid as winter approaches.

items.title: USA - Drei mutmaßlich vom Iran unterstützte Terror-Helfer angeklagt
items.teaser: In den USA sind drei angeblich vom Iran unterstützte Männer wegen der mutmaßlichen Beteiligung an Terroranschlägen angeklagt worden.

items.title: Russia cannot destroy Kyiv HPP with airstrikes, expert says
items.teaser: The Kyiv Hydroelectric Power Plant (HPP) is a highly robust structure that could not realistically be destroyed even by ten Russian missiles, according to an expert.

items.title: Another tanker carrying Russian diesel changes course en route to U.S. – Bloomberg
items.teaser: A tanker carrying Russian diesel fuel, which briefly listed the United States as its destination, changed course about 400 nautical miles from New York, adding to uncertainty over Russian fuel supplies to the North American market.

items.title: Wie Selenskyj den ersten Verhandlungstag einschätzt
items.teaser: Vertreter der Ukraine und Russlands verhandeln unter US-Vermittlung über eine Beendigung des Krieges. Europäische Staaten sitzen bei den Gesprächen nicht direkt mit am Tisch.

items.title: Ukraine reportedly strikes Ust-Luga Baltic Sea port as drones attack regions across Russia
items.teaser: Ukrainian drones struck the Ust-Luga Baltic Sea port in western Russia's Leningrad Oblast overnight on Nov. 11, monitoring channels reported.

items.title: Russia sends a heavier team to the Abu Dhabi peace talks. Four of its five negotiators are on record insisting on the Kremlin’s original war aims
items.teaser: What looks like a push for a deal is the opposite. Russia negotiates to win its war, not to end it, and nothing the West has done gives it a reason to choose peace.

items.title: Revolutionsgarden Auftraggeber?: Drei Iraner wegen Terrorplänen an britischem Militärstützpunkt angeklagt
items.teaser: US-Ermittler machen drei Iraner für zahlreiche Anschlagspläne in Europa und Kanada verantwortlich. Im Auftrag der Revolutionsgarden sollen sie auch den britischen Luftwaffenstützpunkt Fairford ins Visier genommen haben. Das US-Justizministerium veröffentlicht nun die Anklageschrift.

items.title: Ukrainian Red Cross vehicle damaged in Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia
items.teaser: A vehicle belonging to the Ukrainian Red Cross Society was damaged in a Russian attack in Zaporizhzhia on Monday.

items.title: South Africa notifies launch of safeguard investigation into certain non-wired float glass products
items.teaser: On 11 November 2026, South Africa notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 3 November 2026 of a safeguard investigation into imports of certain non-wired float glass products.

items.title: US Senator tells incoming Congress not to give up on Ukraine, supply air defense
items.teaser: "Attempts to pacify Putin are both fantasy and folly by an American president who seems forever enamored by this autocratic Russian leader who is endlessly playing President Trump for a fool," Sen. Richard Durbin said.

items.title: Ukraine has reportedly tested air-launched interceptors at the edge of space. The missile is the easy part
items.teaser: Such missile defenses in the cold of space could stop Russia's Oreshnik. But that doesn't mean those defenses will be ready any time soon.

items.title: SSU detains Dnipro resident suspected of directing Russian strikes
items.teaser: The Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) counterintelligence has exposed a local woman in Dnipro suspected of directing Russian strikes on fuel and energy infrastructure facilities and logistics centers on orders from Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB).

items.title: Russian agent posing as SSU officer sentenced to 15 years for directing strikes on Ochakiv
items.teaser: A Russian agent who impersonated an SSU officer and directed Russian strikes on Ochakiv, Mykolaiv region, has been sentenced to 15 years in prison.

items.title: Großbritannien - US-Soldat wegen mutmaßlicher Spionage für Russland festgenommen

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1721: Abu Dhabi talks open with Russia still demanding the rest of Donetsk Oblast

items.title: US-Justiz klagt angebliche Iran-Helfer wegen Anschlägen an
items.teaser: In den USA werden drei Männer angeklagt. Es geht um Hilfe bei Anschlägen und entsprechenden Plänen - angeblich im Auftrag Teherans. Was legt das Justizministerium ihnen konkret zur Last?

items.title: Prozessauftakt in Aachen - Mann (20) plante Anschlag auf ICE-Fahrgäste
items.teaser: Ein Mann (20) steht jetzt vor Gericht, weil er einen Anschlag auf ICE-Fahrgäste plante.

items.title: Zelensky: Possibility of large-scale prisoner exchange discussed in Abu Dhabi
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that during the talks in Abu Dhabi, the parties discussed the possibility of a large-scale prisoner exchange in a “1,000 for 1,000” or “1,500 for 1,500” format.

items.title: Ukraine strikes drone port at occupied Donetsk Airport
items.teaser: "There should be fewer enemy drones over Ukrainian cities. That's why we are not only intercepting drones that have already been launched, but also destroying the infrastructure from which they are launched," the 412th Brigade of the Unmanned Systems Forces wrote.

items.teaser: Erster Tag der Ukraine-Gespräche in Abu Dhabi beendet

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Erster Tag der Ukraine-Gespräche: Keine Ergebnisse, aber Hoffnung für Gefangene
items.teaser: Der erste Tag der Gespräche zwischen Russland und der Ukraine in Abu Dhabi ist ohne offizielles Ergebnis zu Ende gegangen. Medien berichten aber von einem geplanten Gefangenenaustausch. Eine Waffenruhe scheint dagegen in weiter Ferne.

items.title: Ukraine forecast to see temperatures rise to +19°C on Friday – Meteorologist
items.teaser: An atmospheric front associated with a cyclone will move across Ukraine on Wednesday, November 11, bringing rain and sleet, while warmer weather is expected on Friday, November 13.

items.title: 252 MPs backed Ukraine’s Space Forces. One MP stopped the final vote
items.teaser: The Space Forces are intended to counter, among other threats, Russian ballistic missiles. Bezuhla called the initiative a way to “create a couple more general-level positions.”

items.title: Sybiha urges U.S. to speed up delivery of air defense interceptor missiles
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has urged U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio to speed up the delivery of interceptor missiles for Ukraine’s air defense amid intensified Russian attacks on energy infrastructure ahead of winter.

items.title: Spionage-Vorwürfe: US-Soldat in England festgenommen
items.teaser: Ein Angehöriger des US-Militärs ist im Rahmen von Anti-Terror-Ermittlungen in Großbritannien festgenommen worden.

items.title: Ukraine and Poland to establish joint working groups on drone and counter-drone technologies

items.teaser: Residents of the Svitlovodsk community in Kirovohrad region have been warned of possible gas supply disruptions following an enemy strike.

items.teaser: Merz fordert mehr Engagement aller EU-Staaten für die Ukraine. Der slowakische Präsident wirft dem Kanzler "Erpressung" vor, die Slowakei und Tschechien lehnen weitere Beiträge ab.

items.title: Ukraine seeks to arrange another evacuation for Oleshky residents, Lubinets says
items.teaser: The office of Ukraine's human rights ombudsman, Dmytro Lubinets, continues to receive calls and inquiries from Oleshky residents.

items.teaser: Ukrainian air defenses neutralize 124 hostile drones, 14 Bandrol jet-powered munitions Ukraine’s air defenses have neutralized 124 Russian drones and 14 S8000 Bandrol/Dan-T jet-powered loitering munitions that attacked Ukraine on November 10.

items.title: Drone kills Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant electrician on his way to work, but the IAEA names no attacker
items.teaser: The agency’s record now lists three plant staff deaths since 29 October, one of which is only alleged by Russian officials.

items.teaser: Die Bundeswehr verbietet bestimmte Technik wegen möglicher Spionage.

items.title: One killed and one injured in Russian attack on southern Odesa Oblast

items.teaser: The proposed exchange comes after several months of negotiations between Kyiv and Warsaw.

items.teaser: A Russian drone struck a municipal utility vehicle in Kramatorsk, killing one worker and seriously injuring another.

items.title: Czechia to open CzechBusiness agency Office in Lviv
items.teaser: The Czech government plans to step up support for Czech businesses operating in Ukraine, including by opening a representative office of the CzechBusiness agency in Lviv.

items.title: As old allies leave US Congress, Ukraine must find new champions
items.teaser: The new Congress will have fewer pro-Ukraine champions in both chambers. The biggest losses will come in the House, particularly among Republicans.

items.title: Ukraine, Russia may hold large-scale POW exchange after Abu Dhabi talks, Ukrainian MP says
items.teaser: Ukraine and Russia may conduct another large-scale prisoner-of-war exchange following the talks in Abu Dhabi, but no more significant breakthroughs should be expected, according to a Ukrainian lawmaker.

items.title: Hungary again refuses to give green light to opening EU accession clusters 4 and 5 for Ukraine
items.teaser: Clusters 4 and 5 in Ukraine’s EU accession talks are still unopened after Hungary again withheld approval of the screening results. They cover green policy, agriculture and cohesion, among other areas.

items.title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk Region more than 30 times in one day, killing three and injuring five

items.title: Russia strikes energy infrastructure in Nizhyn

items.title: Ukrainian Human Rights Commissioner's Office working to arrange additional evacuation from Oleshky
items.teaser: Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets says his office is collecting details of residents wishing to leave Russian-occupied Oleshky, with priority given to vulnerable people and families with children.

items.title: South Korea-Ukraine relations begin to thaw after Paris meeting
items.teaser: Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha thanked South Korea for its support for Ukrainian sovereignty, before saying "I am convinced that further steps lie ahead of us towards the full normalization of bilateral relations."

items.title: Serbian company supplied Russia with €27m worth of machine tools for ballistic missiles and aircraft – investigation
items.teaser: An investigation by Radio Liberty's Balkan and Ukrainian services traces Grindex equipment to sanctioned Russian military-industrial complex plants that produce aircraft components, missile systems and military navigation equipment.

items.title: Was, welche Kriegsverbrechen?: US-Minister Hegseth sieht Sabotage, lobt sich und Trump
items.teaser: Es wird ungemütlich für Pentagon-Chef Hegseth, das Repräsentantenhaus könnte für ein Amtsenthebungsverfahren stimmen. Doch der selbstbetitelte "Kriegsminister" weist alle Vorwürfe über Amtsvergehen im Iran, der Karibik und im Jemen von sich. Wer militärisch gewinnt, ist demnach im Recht.

items.title: Dänemark sagt der Ukraine Militärhilfen in Höhe von rund 642 Millionen Euro zu
items.teaser: Dänemark hat am 10. November Bereitstellung neuer Militärhilfen an die Ukraine in Höhe von umgerechnet rund 642 Millionen Euro angekündigt, wie Euronews beichtet.

items.title: South Africa detains nine foreigners suspected of trying to join Russia’s war against Ukraine
items.teaser: Interpol and local law enforcement agencies took part in the investigation.

items.title: Abu Dhabi alks are productive but agreement will take time, Rubio says
items.teaser: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio described the trilateral talks between Ukraine, the United States, and Russia as “very productive,” but stressed that significant work remained before an agreement could be reached.

items.title: Three killed and four injured in Russian strike on critical infrastructure facility in Dnipro
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked a critical infrastructure facility in Dnipro, killing three people and injuring at least four others.

items.title: Ukrainian strikes cut Russia's oil refining capacity by 30%, Reuters reports
items.teaser: Over the past week, Ukrainian attacks disrupted operations or caused emergency situations at nine of Russia's 35 major refineries, according to Reuters.

items.title: Ukrainian drone forces post video of strike on Russian drone base in Donetsk – video
items.teaser: The Nemesis brigade of Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces has released a video showing a successful strike on a Russian drone base in occupied Donetsk.

items.title: USF strike Russian drone hub at Donetsk Airport
items.teaser: Operators of the 412th Nemesis Separate Unmanned Systems Brigade struck a Russian drone hub at Donetsk Airport using middle-strike weapons.

items.title: Diplomaten und Geheimdienstler: Wer vertritt Russland in Abu Dhabi?

items.title: Effectiveness of strikes against Russian forces on Huliaipole axis up 1.5-fold since September, 7th Air Assault Corps says
items.teaser: The effectiveness of strikes against Russian forces in the 7th Air Assault Corps’ area of responsibility on the Huliaipole axis has increased 1.5-fold since the beginning of September.

items.title: Russia plans attacks on Ukraine’s food industry, including foreign-owned factories, in new campaign against civilian economy, intelligence source warns
items.teaser: Moscow aims to damage Ukraine's food security and weaken its agricultural exports, according to a HUR source.

items.title: Release of POWs, security guarantees discussed on first day of Abu Dhabi talks
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that Ukraine, the United States, and Russia discussed humanitarian measures, the release of prisoners of war, security guarantees, and de-escalation during the first day of talks in Abu Dhabi.

items.title: Russen greifen kritische Infrastruktur in Dnipro an: es gibt Tote und Verletzte
items.teaser: Russisches Militär hat kritische Infrastruktur in der Stadt Dnipro angegriffen. Es gibt Tote und Verletzte, teilt der Leiter der regionalen MIlitärverwaltung, Oleksandr Hanža, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Russian companies seek foreign data center capacity after Ukrainian strikes
items.teaser: Ukraine's strikes added pressure to an already strained domestic data center market, where available cloud resources are nearly 90% occupied, according to Russian state-controlled media Kommersant.

items.title: Government discusses 2027 Ukraine funding plan with international donors
items.teaser: The Cabinet of Ministers expects to reach agreements with international partners on funding for Ukraine in 2027 by the end of November.

items.title: Ukrainian forces rescue wounded soldier using bomber drone, electric unicycle and ground robot
items.teaser: Ukrainian forces from the Chervona Kalyna Brigade have conducted a complex evacuation on the Dobropillia front, using a drone to deliver blood and a ground robotic system to extract a wounded serviceman.

items.title: South Korea earmarks US$100m for Ukraine in 2027 draft budget

items.title: Denmark pledges €643 million in military aid to Ukraine
items.teaser: Denmark announced a new military aid package for Ukraine worth DKK 4.8 billion (€643 million) on Tuesday, November 10.

items.title: Was können die Gespräche zum Ukraine-Krieg bringen?

items.title: Energy to top agenda of Czech business delegation's visit to Ukraine
items.teaser: Energy will be the main focus of a visit to Ukraine by a Czech business delegation led by First Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Industry and Trade Karel Havlíček, as Prague has long-standing cooperation with Kyiv in this sector.

items.title: The Kyiv Independent turns 5, makes 5 promises for the year ahead

items.title: Rubio says Abu Dhabi talks were productive, but "a lot of work" remains to be done – Sky News
items.teaser: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has said the trilateral negotiations in the UAE were productive, stating that a significant amount of work remains.

items.title: Russian oil refining capacity cut by about one-third following Ukrainian strikes – Reuters
items.teaser: The resumption of Ukrainian attacks on Russian oil refineries since late October has reduced Russia's oil refining capacity by approximately 30%.

items.teaser: Russland bereitet Angriffe auf Lebensmittel-Unternehmen in der Ukraine vor– sowohl auf ukrainische, als auch ausländische.

items.teaser: Russland hat die Ukraine in der Nacht erneut mit Luftangriffen überzogen. Dabei starben ukrainischen Angaben zufolge zwei Menschen. Zudem seien mehrere Umspannwerke getroffen worden, in mehreren Regionen fiel der Strom aus.

items.title: Russian forces seek to isolate Zaporizhzhia by striking bridges, dams, Ukrainian commander says
items.teaser: The developments come amid growing pressure on Ukraine's defenses in Zaporizhzhia Oblast.

items.title: Cyberangriffe auf Supermärkte: Darum greift Iran Europas Kühlregale an
items.teaser: Die Sabotage an Kühlanlagen in ganz Europa folgt einem Kalkül. Experten erklären, warum Teheran ausgerechnet Supermärkte ins Visier nimmt – und dabei kaum etwas riskiert.

items.title: Russia’s jet-powered Geran-4 can outrun the American Lancer 7 interceptor drone tested in Ukraine

items.teaser: Russia is preparing attacks on food industry facilities, targeting both Ukrainian and foreign-owned businesses operating in Ukraine.

items.teaser: More than two years ago, then EU foreign policy chief Josep Borrell said EU states had agreed to a center in Kyiv.

items.title: Recent Ukrainian strikes have reduced Russian oil processing capacity by 30%, says Reuters
items.teaser: Renewed drone attacks on major Russian refineries have disrupted operations at nine key facilities, reducing domestic crude processing capacity by roughly 30%.

items.title: Proteste vor Haus bei Kiew: Keine Belege für ein ukrainisches Foltergefängnis
items.teaser: Gewaltsame Proteste, ein verstörter Teenager, eine verzweifelte Ärztin: Im Internet verbreiten sich Bilder mit Behauptungen über die Entdeckung eines ukrainischen Foltergefängnisses bei Kiew. Was ist dazu bekannt? Von C. Reveland und K. König.

items.title: Ukraine-Verhandlungen: "Beide Seiten stehen unter enormem Zugzwang"
items.teaser: Russland und die Ukraine stehen unter großem Zeitdruck, sagt der Militärexperte Markus Reisner. Doch ohne Zugeständnisse werde es keinen Erfolg bei den Verhandlungen geben. Wichtig seien auch mögliche Gespräche über eine neue Sicherheitsordnung.

items.title: Warum sitzt Deutschland in Abu Dhabi nicht am Verhandlungstisch?
items.teaser: Derzeit treffen sich in Abu Dhabi Vertreter der Ukraine, Russlands und der USA, um Gespräche über ein Ende des Krieges wieder aufzunehmen. Europa scheint im Abseits, obwohl Deutschland der größte Unterstützer der Ukraine ist. Von N. Markwald.

items.title: Zakarpattia considering hotels and sanatoriums to house displaced Ukrainians over winter
items.teaser: The Zakarpattia Regional Military Administration is exploring options to involve private sanatoriums and other business-owned accommodation facilities in housing internally displaced persons (IDPs), with the possibility of subsequent state compensation for rental costs.

items.title: Resetting relations: Ukrainian foreign minister will meet South Korean counterpart in Paris
items.teaser: Andrii Sybiha and Cho Hyun will discuss ways to ease diplomatic tensions, resume dialogue and agree on further steps in Ukrainian-South Korean cooperation during the G7 summit.

items.title: Ukraine strikes Russian plant responsible for repairing A-50 spy planes, General Staff confirms
items.teaser: Overnight on November 10, Ukraine's Defense Forces struck a plant in Russia's Novgorod region that repairs A-50 airborne early warning aircraft.

items.title: Der Fall Nvidia enthüllt Chinas globale Spionagestrategie
items.teaser: Nvidia-Chef Jensen Huang räumt eine Affäre ein, seine Geliebte steht unter Spionageverdacht. Der Fall wirft ein Schlaglicht auf Chinas Methoden, um über persönliche Kontakte an westliche Schlüsseltechnologien und vertrauliche Informationen zu gelangen.

items.title: Gespräche mit Russland und USA für heute beendet
items.teaser: Die Gespräche zwischen der Ukraine, Russland und den USA in Abu Dhabi über eine mögliche Beendigung des Krieges sind für heute beendet. Die Verhandlungen werden morgen früh, am 11. November, fortgesetzt, teilt der Pressedienst des Auslandsgeheimdienstes der Ukraine mit.

items.title: Ukraine's Defence Intelligence uncovers Russian plans to strike food industry
items.teaser: Intelligence sources indicate that Moscow is preparing to target agricultural storage, processing plants, and food production facilities to damage the Ukrainian economy.

items.title: Zelenskyy briefly discusses Abu Dhabi talks with Ukrainian delegation
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has received a briefing from Ukraine’s delegation on the trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi and plans to discuss their results in greater detail later.

items.title: Russian businesses reserve foreign data centre capacities following drone strikes
items.teaser: Local businesses in Russia are increasingly transferring their data storage to foreign sites, particularly in Kazakhstan, following a series of UAV strikes on server infrastructure inside Russia.

items.title: Ukraine-US-Russia talks in Abu Dhabi adjourn until tomorrow
items.teaser: Today's round of trilateral talks between Ukraine, the United States and Russia on ending the war has concluded in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates. Negotiations will resume tomorrow morning, November 11.

items.title: Russia planning strikes on Ukraine's food industry, military intelligence source says
items.teaser: Russia has repeatedly targeted Ukraine's food supply chains in recent months. In August, Russian strikes hit distribution centers belonging to major supermarket chains, including Silpo and Novus, leaving some Kyiv stores with empty shelves and shortages of everyday products such as vegetables, dairy, and meat.

items.title: 'I think he's an idiot' — Australian man who joined Russian army missing, feared dead in Ukraine
items.teaser: Daryl Fladung, a 38-year-old security guard from Queensland, traveled to Moscow in April despite having no previous military experience or known family ties to Eastern Europe.

items.title: Ukraine’s drone detector Pluton can now hear the mesh links that make Russian drones harder to jam, developer says

items.title: Major prisoner swap agreed at Abu Dhabi talks – source
items.teaser: A source says Ukraine, the US and Russia have reached a deal in Abu Dhabi on a large-scale prisoner exchange expected to take place soon.

items.title: Generalstab bestätigt Angriff auf Flugzeugreparaturwerk in Russland
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte haben in der Nacht zum 10. November ein Flugzeugreparaturwerk in der Stadt Staraja Russa in der russischen Region Nowgorod angegriffen. Dort werden unter anderem Frühwarnaufklärungsflugzeuge vom Typ A-50 repariert und gewartet.

items.title: Russian forces seeking to expand their incursion in Velykyi Burluk area – Tregubov
items.teaser: Russian troops in the Vovchansk area are attempting to advance towards Vilcha, Vovchanski Khutory and Bilyi Kolodiaz, but there have been no significant changes to the frontline so far.

items.title: Slovak PM criticises Germany's Merz over threat to block EU budget without funding for Ukraine – Reuters
items.teaser: Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico accuses German Chancellor Friedrich Merz of blackmail after Germany linked its support for the 2028-2034 EU budget to a commitment by all member states to fund Ukraine.

items.title: EU defense commissioner: Starlink could lose trust if it breaks contracts European countries pay for
items.teaser: Ukraine should get access to the EU’s GOVSATCOM from 2027, Kubilius says, but he rates it below the bloc’s planned IRIS² system.

items.title: Day one in Abu Dhabi: US officials’ “real shot” again runs into Russia’s unchanged demand for the rest of Donetsk Oblast, unacceptable for Ukraine
items.teaser: US officials expect no final deal from the two-day round, and Russia’s delegation came to discuss Europe’s security order rather than a ceasefire.

items.title: G7 foreign ministers' meeting on support for Ukraine begins in Paris
items.teaser: A working session of the foreign ministers of the Group of Seven (G7), focused on support for Ukraine, has begun in Paris. Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha is taking part.

items.title: Ukraine takes step toward joining European payments network with anti-graft law
items.teaser: In total, 249 MPs supported Bill No. 14327-d, which brings Ukrainian regulation in line with EU standards, in its first reading, lawmaker Yaroslav Zhelezniak from the Holos Party reported on his Telegram channel.

items.title: Zelensky: Fastest way to end war lies in holding positions and moving to negotiations
items.teaser: The fastest way to end the active phase of the war is to establish a ceasefire along the current line of contact and move on to negotiations.

items.title: Denmark says it outgives much bigger countries for its size—its 32nd Ukraine package is mostly air defense
items.teaser: The foreign minister calls Denmark the biggest donor to Ukraine relative to its size, and most of the new package goes to air defense.

items.title: Defense Forces retain control of Kupiansk as Russian troops try to advance from North – Trehubov
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces retain control of Kupiansk in Kharkiv region, while Russian troops are attempting to advance on the city’s northern approaches, particularly toward Radkivka and Kindrashivka.

items.title: Russen haben in der Nacht fünf große Umspannwerke in der Ukraine angegriffen
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum 10. November hat die russische Armee fünf große Umspannwerke angegriffen, über die der Strom zwischen den Regionen übertragen wird, teilt der Ministerpräsident Serhij Korezkyj auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Zelensky explains why Ukraine cannot trade Donbas for security guarantees
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that conceding Donbas would not guarantee peace for Ukraine, as Kremlin leader Vladimir Putin could use such a move merely as a pause before launching another act of aggression.

items.title: Russian forces attack Zaporizhzhia with drones, sparking fire, injuring residents
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia with strike drones. Private homes were hit, and residents were injured.

items.title: Pentagon bestätigt baldige Waffenlieferungen an Ukraine im Wert von 400 Millionen Dollar – Diplomat
items.teaser: Das Pentagon hat der ukrainischen Seite mitgeteilt, dass die Ukraine in Kürze Waffen im Wert von 400 Millionen US-Dollar erhalten kann, die im Rahmen des USAI-Programms für dieses Jahr vorgesehen sind.

items.title: Zelensky discusses trilateral meeting in Abu Dhabi with Stubb
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed trilateral talks between Ukraine, the United States, and Russia in Abu Dhabi with Finnish President Alexander Stubb, stressing that Russia must also be committed to de-escalation and achieving genuine peace.

items.title: Il-76s haul Russia’s troops, Il-78s refuel its bombers—drones likely went after the plant that fixes both
items.teaser: Monitoring channels reported a fire at the Staraya Russa repair plant, and Novgorod's governor acknowledged damage to an industrial facility he did not name.

items.title: Commander of Ukraine's 7th Air Assault Corps explains why defenders withdrew from Pokrovsk
items.teaser: Yevhen Lasiychuk, commander of Ukraine's 7th Air Assault Corps, said that in the summer of 2025, the Defense Forces gave up Pokrovsk in Donetsk region in order to deploy reserves to Dobropillia and thwart Russia's plans to encircle the entire Donetsk region.

items.title: Ukraine says it hit a Russian Starlink jammer in occupied Donetsk Oblast, a week after an adviser warned Russia is fielding more
items.teaser: Ukrainian units have been hunting such systems since Russia resumed using them this year.

items.title: Was von den Ukraine-Gesprächen in Abu Dhabi zu erwarten ist

items.title: No enemy activity observed in Chernihiv region or along border with Belarus – Demchenko
items.teaser: Russian forces are not conducting offensive operations directly along the border in Chernihiv region, and no active enemy movements have been observed along the border with Belarus.

items.title: Russia destroys Epicentr home improvement hypermarket in Kropyvnytskyi
items.teaser: Russian forces struck an Epicentr shopping centre in Kropyvnytskyi on 10 November.
